premises.text: Social feeds are too noisy, so the content people care about gets lost amid low-value posts and invites
premises.evidence_span: The problem is it's just way too noisy

premises.text: A mobile community focused only on sharing and discovering compelling web content, without status updates, check-ins, or game invites
premises.evidence_span: no status updates, no check-ins, no game invites. It's all about sharing and discovering the most interesting and compelling content

premises.text: Connecting existing social networks lets an algorithm surface the best content with friend social context and implicit interests plus serendipity
premises.evidence_span: it'll analyze all the content that's coming through, and it'll surface the best stuff

premises.text: Users can follow tastemaker curators and reshare drips out to chosen networks
premises.evidence_span: discover, who are the tastemakers? Who are the best curators on UnDrip

value.text: Busy people discover and share the gems of the web without social noise
value.evidence_span: helps you discover and share the gems of the web

causal_links.evidence_span: the stuff that we most care about gets lost

notes: Tweet/Facebook volume and jibba-jabba examples folded into noise problem (§4.1.6). Feed sections, implicit interests, serendipity, and drip reshare folded into discovery algorithm/community cascade (§4.1.7). Chegg bio excluded. Mobile App Store availability as packaging of mobile-community premise. Two domains.
